rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is more advantageous, preferable, or better in comparison.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 hou2 di1

rows.note: Use this after a number or measurement for the “that amount or better” sense, meaning that amount or more.
Use this when a person or thing has recovered and is no longer as ill or damaged.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 ji4 gaa1 hou2 faan1 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when “better” means a greater amount or quantity.

example.english: It’s better to add more salt so the soup will taste right.
example.jyutping: lok6 do1 di1 jim4 go3 tong1 sin1 gau3 mei6
